signals.summary: Jeppesen ForeFlight laid off a large number of employees; reports estimated 30-50% of staff, disputed by the company.
Company statement confirms layoffs tied to streamlining its operating model, while disputing reported percentages as overstated.
Private equity firm Thoma Bravo bought Jeppesen and ForeFlight from Boeing and merged them into one Denver-based business.
Thoma Bravo acquired Boeing's Digital Aviation Solutions, including ForeFlight, Jeppesen, AerData and Oz Runways.
